note: Code-inspected evidence; live WAL/TOAST timings require APPCALL_ENGINE_POSTGRES_URL. Open-scan visits only recoverable=true via index (O(K)), validates blob, bumps wakeup. Passive waits are not decoded. No multi-worker SKIP LOCKED.

evidence.advisory_lock: PostgresStore::from_client uses pg_try_advisory_lock(OWNER_LOCK); Conflict if not owned
evidence.session_not_txn_pool: lib.rs docs: dedicated database/schema with direct sessions, never a transaction-pooling proxy
evidence.record_cap_enforced: CREATE TABLE ... record BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(record)<=1048576) plus encoded() Limit
evidence.blob_rewrite_vs_history_depth: SKIPPED_NO_LIVE_PG — full-row BYTEA rewrite on every commit; cost grows with serde size of history (same 1MiB cap as SQLite)
evidence.open_scan_at_n_running: recover_running SELECTs id,record WHERE state=running AND recoverable (indexed); O(K) not O(N). Denormalized recoverable on insert/commit. Passive waits skipped.
